<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation
DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 contains three DSpark MTP stages, corresponding to dspark_target_layer_ids=[40, 41, 42] , while num_nextn_predict_layers is set to 1 .

The existing DSV4 KV cache accounting therefore reserves memory for only one draft layer, although the draft model allocates SWA KV cache for three stages. This underestimates draft KV memory and can over-size the target KV pool, increasing the risk of OOM during long generation.

- Original hardcoded one-layer estimate: reserves approximately 1,056.8 bytes per full token , underestimating the actual draft KV cost by about 345 bytes and potentially causing OOM.
- Direct 3/43 layer-ratio scaling: reserves approximately 3,170.5 bytes per full token , overestimating the cost by about 1,769 bytes and reducing token capacity by roughly 3.8% , which may prevent scheduling from making progress.
- Current packed-SWA formula: reserves 1,401.6 bytes per full token , matching the actual three-stage DSV4 draft SWA layout.

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

- Resolve the bundled DSV4 DSpark draft layer count from len(dspark_target_layer_ids) .
- Propagate the resolved count through SpecAuxHiddenStateConfig.dflash_draft_num_layers .
- Use the resolved draft layer count in DSV4 KV cache memory accounting instead of assuming one draft layer.
- Add CPU unit tests covering bundled DSV4 DSpark stage resolution and pool accounting.

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

         config.dflash_draft_num_layers = int(draft_num_layers)

@@ -637,8 +637,8 @@ class DSV4PoolConfigurator(MemoryPoolConfigurator):
     """Configurator for DSV4 compressed-attention models.
 
     Splits available memory across full / swa / c4 / c128 + c4_state / c128_state
-    pools. coeff is bytes_per_full_token (inflated by (T+D)/T when speculative
-    decode reserves a draft worker, mirroring dflash's cell_size scaling); bias = 0.
+    pools. Draft packed-SWA storage is an additive bytes-per-full-token term;
+    bias = 0.
     """
 
     def __init__(self, kvc: KVCacheConfigurator):
@@ -647,6 +647,9 @@ def __init__(self, kvc: KVCacheConfigurator):
         self.qk_nope_head_dim = cfg.qk_nope_head_dim
         self.qk_rope_head_dim = cfg.qk_rope_head_dim
         self.indexer_head_dim = cfg.index_head_dim
+        self.swa_kv_bytes_per_token = (
+            self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.qk_rope_head_dim * 2 + 8
+        )
         self.context_len = kvc.model_config.context_len
         # PP-local slice; matches DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool's stage_ratios.
         self.compression_ratios = cfg.compress_ratios[
@@ -700,13 +703,17 @@ def __init__(self, kvc: KVCacheConfigurator):
 
         self.bytes_per_full_token = self._get_bytes_per_full_token()
         if self.is_speculative:
-            # Reserve memory for the speculative draft worker by inflating
-            # per-token bytes by (target+draft)/target. Equivalent to dflash's
-            # scale_kv_cell_size_per_token_for_dflash but applied to
-            # bytes_per_full_token: tokens = avail / (bpft * (T+D)/T).
-            draft_layers = 1
-            target_layers = self.num_layers_total
-            self.bytes_per_full_token *= (target_layers + draft_layers) / target_layers
+            # DSV4 draft stages allocate only the packed SWA pool. Do not price
+            # them as average target layers, which also include C4/C128,
+            # indexer, and compression-state storage.
+            draft_layers = (
+                kvc.spec_aux_config.dflash_draft_num_layers
+                or kvc.spec_aux_config.eagle_draft_num_layers
+                or 1
+            )
+            self.bytes_per_full_token += (
+                self.swa_ratio * self.swa_kv_bytes_per_token * draft_layers
+            )
 
         # Online c128 keeps a single in-progress (max, sum, kv) state per index
         # and assumes a strict forward-only schedule. Speculative decode (MTP)

-        kv_bytes = self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.qk_rope_head_dim * 2 + 8
+        kv_bytes = self.swa_kv_bytes_per_token
 
         quant_block_size = 128
         indexer_bytes = (

@@ -737,6 +737,39 @@ def _tokens(draft_kv_per_token):
 
         self.assertLess(_tokens(10240), _tokens(None))
 
+    def test_dsv4_budget_prices_dspark_as_packed_swa_only(self):
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.pool_configurator import DSV4PoolConfigurator
+
+        mr = _make_model_runner(
+            num_layers=3,
+            is_hybrid_swa=True,
+            swa_full_tokens_ratio=0.8,
+            speculative_algorithm="DSPARK",
+            max_speculative_num_draft_tokens=6,
+            max_running_requests=8,
+        )
+        mr.model_config.qk_nope_head_dim = 448
+        mr.model_config.qk_rope_head_dim = 64
+        mr.model_config.index_head_dim = 128
+        mr.model_config.window_size = 128
+        mr.model_config.compress_ratios = [0, 4, 128]
+        mr.server_args.enable_hisparse = False
+        mr.spec_aux_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            eagle_draft_num_layers=None,
+            dflash_draft_num_layers=3,
+            dflash_draft_cell_size_per_token=None,
+        )
+
+        with mock_cpu_env():
+            configurator = DSV4PoolConfigurator(mr)
+
+        target_only_bytes = configurator._get_bytes_per_full_token()
+        draft_swa_bytes = 0.8 * (448 + 64 * 2 + 8) * 3
+        self.assertEqual(
+            configurator.bytes_per_full_token,
+            target_only_bytes + draft_swa_bytes,
+        )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
